name: CodeBlock
description: Styled preformatted code block for displaying a literal source string with a declared programming or markup language.

root.description: Preformatted code container that preserves whitespace and provides the visual block surface.

code.description: Literal source text rendered through the highlight content transform: one token span per syntax token when the highlight gate is enabled, a single plain text run otherwise. Never interpreted markup.

source.description: Automatic literal source renderer used when no consumer content is supplied.

line.description: One lossless source line; reusable by annotated consumer content.

gutter.description: Presentational line number excluded from the accessible and copied source.

token.description: Single syntax-token span produced by the highlight transform. Carries the token's literal text and a data-token kind attribute from the CodeBlockTokenType vocabulary; text-only by construction.

members.name: code
members.description: Literal source text to display. The value is rendered as text and must not be treated as HTML.

members.name: language
members.description: Declared language driving the highlight content transform's tokenizer, and retained for documentation and downstream adapters.

members.name: highlight
members.description: Gate for the highlight content transform. When true (default) the source is rendered as one span per syntax token; when false it is rendered as a single plain text run.

members.name: tokens
members.description: Optional lossless syntax token stream. Invalid streams render the canonical code as plain text.

members.name: showLineNumbers
members.description: Display a presentational one-based line gutter without adding numbers to the source text.

usageHints: Use code for the literal source string; do not pass pre-rendered HTML
Set language to the closest supported language enum value
Use plaintext when the content has no meaningful syntax language
Set highlight to false to render the source as a single plain text run without token spans
Use CodeSnippet for inline code, keyboard keys, or sample output
Optional consumer content supplies annotated source inside the code region; when present it replaces the automatic source renderer. Keep code as the canonical source string.
